rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: KORdiam
Exhibition name: Holsteinperle
rows.Bloom: Coral and salmon-orange. None / no fragrance. 40 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, double (17-25 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Medium, bushy. Medium, semi-glossy, medium green foliage.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
